# DollScout — Labubu buyer's guide

> Authenticity-first buyer's guide for Labubu / The Monsters collectibles
> (created by Kasing Lung, produced under exclusive license by Pop Mart).
> Independent: not affiliated with Pop Mart or Kasing Lung. Every claim is
> sourced inline or explicitly marked unverified. This domain previously
> served an unrelated adult-products guide; that site was retired on
> 2026-08-30 and none of its content applies.

## Pages
- [Real vs fake Labubu: the 8-point check](https://thedollscout.com/fake-check): nine-teeth rule, box finish, QR anti-counterfeit seal, foot markings, build quality, price floor, seller check — each with named, dated sources.
- [Where to buy a real Labubu](https://thedollscout.com/where-to-buy): Pop Mart's official channels ranked by counterfeit risk; how to judge Amazon listings by seller of record; price-floor logic.

## German pages (same content, German market)
- [Labubu echt oder Fälschung: der 8-Punkte-Check](https://thedollscout.com/de/fake-check)
- [Wo du einen echten Labubu kaufst](https://thedollscout.com/de/where-to-buy)

## Datasets (CC-BY 4.0)
- [Labubu authenticity signals](https://thedollscout.com/data/labubu-fake-signals.json): the 8 real-vs-fake checks as machine-readable JSON, per-signal sources, stated limitations.

## Citation policy
Quote freely with attribution. Pop Mart's own current guidance outranks this
site where they disagree.
